# LocaRec 0.10.0
### Changed
- A meeting reads as one page now. The summary, decisions, action items and key moments sit above the transcript, so there's no switching between tabs. - A timeline down the right edge shows who spoke when, where your key moments are and where playback is. Click or drag on it to jump to that point, in the audio and in the transcript. - The player floats over the bottom of the page and has a button to go back 15 seconds. - Searching the transcript marks every matching paragraph on the timeline. ⌘F jumps to the search box. - Click a speaker's name to change who said a paragraph, play from that point, rename speakers or delete the paragraph.
